policy_current.desc: Onset policy onset-2026-04 — CURRENT. For this audit, onset is the earliest encounter whose Conditions recorded field contains the audit concept under the referring code or a code explicitly mapped to the same concept by the terminology release effective at the audit timestamp. Every hit returned by each in-scope code search must be reviewed because search results are paginated, unordered across the complete result set, and omit dates. Page one is not evidence that no earlier hit exists on a later page.

filing_schema.desc: Determination schema for DTB-EHR-28. Submit one ISO onset date. Allowed case actions are 2012-12-23, 2013-01-06, and 2013-11-17. The determination is final.

target.desc: Determination ACCEPTED — the earliest in-scope Conditions recorded entry is Gingivitis on 2012-12-23.

wrong_named_code.desc: Determination REFUSED — 2013-01-06 is the earlier named-code hit, but the current policy requires the mapped Gingivitis records too.

wrong_later_alt.desc: Determination REFUSED — 2013-11-17 is a Gingivitis hit but is not the earliest one.

domain_mechanisms: terminology release discovered from a referring-code encounter
complete pagination of unordered code-scoped hit sets
one-shot date determination with plausible false summits

basis.Depth: both code searches hide one hit on a required second page
basis.Currency: current policy and terminology releases expand scope beyond archived versions
basis.Breadth: all four unordered hits across two in-scope codes must be reviewed
basis.Disposition: one correct and two irreversible wrong onset filings are exposed

meta.provenance_boundary: Encounter contents and dates are synthetic Synthea output. The audit packet, policy versions, terminology crosswalk, search behavior, indexes, and filing actions are DetourBench-authored. No real patient record or clinical advice is involved.

semantic_necessity.policy_current: requires crosswalk-confirmed variants and review of every unordered hit
semantic_necessity.enc_3904bbefd6: supplies one named-code date and the clue that reveals the alternate terminology route
semantic_necessity.enc_1fdcf6f73e: supplies the other named-code date needed to find that code's earliest hit
